protocol.scaling_criterion: Highest five-seed FINAL screen mean among alternatives; ties lower deaths then name; restart control and alternative from scratch at 16M
protocol.test_criterion: Highest validation mean across all corrected-objective main checkpoints; ties lower deaths, fewer steps, run name. Legacy controls excluded. Test once after all trials finish.

changes_from_control.long_rollout: 512-step fragments and 16 minibatches keep 2048 samples/minibatch; batch/refresh cadence also changes
changes_from_control.memory: residual LSTM global memory on the same target encoder/scorer; extra parameters, sequence minibatches and recurrent dynamics also change
changes_from_control.novelty: generic balanced RND, coefficient .001, not annealed; bonus capped .005/action; extrinsic evaluation unchanged

protocol.note: Five paired training seeds are exploratory. Equal transitions are not equal compute. Old consumed splits are not used for selection/test. No default checkpoint promotion.

scaling_selection.criterion: Highest five-seed FINAL screen mean among alternatives; ties lower deaths then name; restart control and alternative from scratch at 16M

selection.criterion: highest validation mean; ties: lower death rate, fewer steps, run name
selection.note: Selection frozen before test. The reserved split is now consumed; do not tune against its results.

previous-policy-deadline-audit.json.note: Terminal value must be zero for the finite objective. These are learned critic predictions, not measured future rewards. Validation diagnostic only.

selected-deadline-audit.json.note: Terminal value must be zero for the finite objective. These are learned critic predictions, not measured future rewards. Validation diagnostic only.

coarse_equal_wall_snapshots.note: Last recorded checkpoint at or before the shortest final scaling wall time. Coarse 4M intervals, contention/validation included; not exact equal-compute trials.
